title: Kestrel and the Well
author: Tamsin Dravenmoor
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
